entries.author: bbolen83
entries.original: Robotic tests can also return predictions to biology. \citet{ijspeert_swimming_2007} implemented a spinal-cord model in a salamander robot that switched between walking and swimming as control drive changed. The model predicted lower intrinsic frequencies for limb oscillators than for body oscillators, and the authors presented biological data supporting that prediction. This exchange illustrates the broader motivation for the humanoid project: biological evidence informs a controllable model, whose behavior can generate questions for subsequent biological experiments.
